synbiotics and phytochemicals can be considered as a promising tool in the management of gut health in poultry, but further investigations are necessary.

synbiotics and/or phytobiotics are not recommended as feed additives in the diet of broilers.
the combination of phytobiotic and synbiotic is a good alternative in the broiler industry.

The main takeaway from our work is that
synbiotics and/or phytobiotics could be used as feed additives to improve broilers’ performance.
phytobiotics are a good alternative to antibiotic growth promoters in broilers, but the use of phytobiotic and synbiotic together may not be a good strategy.
the combination of synbiotic plus phytobiotics is more beneficial in terms of gut health, but it is not recommended to be used as a growth promoter.
